exposure: Interpregnancy BMI increase of ≥1 to <2 units
Interpregnancy BMI change of -1 to +1 unit
Interpregnancy BMI increase of 2 to <3 units
finding: Every 1-unit increase in interpregnancy BMI was associated with increased risks of GDM, PE, GHtn, and primary cesarean delivery, and decreased risk of successful VBAC in the second pregnancy.
mod_finding: An interpregnancy BMI increase of ≥3 units is associated with an increased risk of primary cesarean delivery and decreased risk of successful VBAC.
